name: Zoom Canvas
description: Draws the second input zoomed around an anchor point onto the first input (a fixed-size, e.g. transparent, canvas), keeping its aspect ratio.

inputs.name: canvas
inputs.description: Background that sets the output size (e.g. a transparent color source at the largest size)

params.name: zoom
params.description: Size of the picture relative to its fitted size (1 = fitted as set by fit)

params.name: fit
params.description: Size at zoom 1: 0 contain (whole picture inside the canvas), 1 cover (fills the canvas), 2 native pixels

params.name: anchor
params.description: Canvas point (0..1 of its size) where the picture's pivot is placed

params.name: pivot
params.description: Point of the picture (0..1 of its size) that stays on the anchor while zooming
